profile.name: Callum Beckwith
profile.title: Lead Software Engineer
profile.intro: I’m a software developer and team lead at PSSG, working across AI, full-stack development and product direction. I led the engineering behind Capture Expense, helping take it from early development to a seven-figure business.
profile.subtitle: I lead teams, modernise software and put AI to work.

experience.label: Now
experience.description: Driving the modernisation of Cintra People HR, bringing the experience of scaling Capture Expense to the product’s next stage. Shaping a better user experience and identifying where AI can simplify everyday HR work.

experience.label: Joined 2023
experience.context: Technical Lead · Part of the PSSG
experience.description: Led development through the startup phase and helped scale Capture Expense into a seven-figure business. Turned customer needs into product direction, scoped and built the solutions, and drove practical AI opportunities across the product.
Built software to audit millions of financial records for major UK and US businesses, while leading sprints and guiding the work of other developers.

experience.label: From 2018
experience.description: Ran a client-facing design and development partnership, turning business briefs into brand identities, websites and full-stack software.
Combined design and development to deliver blog systems, Welcome Week pages and wider student-facing web experiences, with work reaching thousands of students.
Combined software development with stock management across three companies, building bespoke tools for inventory analysis.

background: At PSSG, I lead technical development for Cintra People HR. I set the technical direction for the work, guide the team through delivery and stay hands-on with development. I’m modernising the interface and exploring where AI can make the product more useful.

At Capture Expense, one of the UK’s leading AI-powered expense platforms, I led development through the startup phase and helped grow the business to seven figures. My work stretched across client conversations, the roadmap, product direction and delivery: understanding what people needed, shaping the solution and building it.

At Audit Partnership, I built data-heavy software used to audit millions of financial records, including accounts payable and receivable data, for major UK and US businesses. I led sprints, guided and mentored developers, and contributed to technical interviews.
With Webur, I ran a freelance design and development partnership, working directly with clients to turn their ideas into branding, websites and software.
education: BSc Computer Science · First Class Honours · Sheffield Hallam University
